Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sending the files. Confirming I received the CSV and SOC2 link stub. Next steps from Redwood's side:

1) Fill vendor information form (one-time) — link: https://portal.redwoodinference.com/vendor-form?ref=DL-34872
2) DPA: we can send a DocuSign envelope for Hearthline to sign (preferred) or accept an already-signed DPA PDF. I will start the DocuSign flow unless you prefer to push a PDF back.
3) SOC 2: please point the link to a hosted report or provide a PDF if the report is gated. Our security team needs the AICPA SOC 2 report (Type II, last 12 months) or a read-only link.
4) Subprocessors: CSV is perfect. We'll ingest the list into our vendor inventory and run the standard mapping; if anything looks like a disallowed subprocessor we'll raise a follow-up.
5) Finance needs the bank remittance + W-9 to route the PO. Our AP contact is laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com.

Timeline: if you can complete steps 1–4 by EOD Wednesday (2028-03-24), we should be able to issue a PO the week of 2028-03-27. I'll assign Laura to finalize the PO routing once we have the signed DPA and bank info.

I'll start the DocuSign DPA now and will share the envelope link here once created. Thanks — looping in Laura for PO/finance follow-up and Ben for commercial alignment.

Regards,
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
